output.objection: I did not just want a signature on a document, I wanted a named person who answers when the forecast breaks at 4 a.m. A formal owner sign off is the floor, not the ceiling, for what I am asking for.
output.correction: You misread my note as a governance formality, but I meant it as a reliability commitment. The sign off is the mechanism that makes the risk assessment actionable for my deployment pipeline.
